sources_admitted.evidence: Finance Canada release and product table, PC 2026-0785, CBSA notices, White House proclamations and fact sheet, Census c1220, Statistics Canada Daily, USTR Canada page, Carney August 22 remarks, and coverage including Reuters via MarketScreener were admitted through the capture registry.

derived_numbers_computed.evidence: src/data/canadatariffs202609.mjs counts 629 list lines, 335 Order lines, 17 and 33 days, and 20/333.6197 = 6.0 percent from the pinned Census CSV and the dated records.

outlet_claims_verified.evidence: The Hill 700 and 6 percent next to $27.6 billion is mislabeled against the 629-line table. Al Jazeera $5.42 billion is not in the Finance release; BBC printed C$7.5bn. AP 6 percent of $333.6 billion checks out on Census. BBC conversion of nearly C$28bn ($20bn) is consistent with Detroit News C$27.6 billion ($19.94 billion). Guardian C$ is consistent as the outlet's label.
